scope: Stage1 only two existing snapshots, M16, Q64 real evaluation, Page64, K41 own protected, one swap only, all410 pages sampled. No neural training, new data or production change.
sampling: independent per-event/seed/page/group uniform WITHOUT replacement permutations, nested first b; no truth-based selection; plan hash locked before evaluation
panels: PRIMARY Medium:16 lowest Risk selected non-own removals and32 highest Risk unselected additions (stable sort ties pageID); SECONDARY full14760 legal swaps to diagnose selection noise
independent: same sampled N/Z, same estimated Dense center; per-page s_p=mean_M ||e_p||^2 / Ztilde_D^2; one swap maximizes s_add-s_remove within same pool, positive score else no-op. Does NOT reroute41 pages; this controls one-action strength and uses no set interaction.
set: estimated Dense output from all sampled pages, candidate mixed outputs from same sampled N/Z and original summary; optimize squared difference averaged16 Queries, no true Dense/trueC in policy
noop: base:positive predicted gain only. Independent-repeat diagnostic pairs17->29 and43->71: proposed action from first seed accepted only if second seed scores SAME action positive; second samples are extra cost, no true-label gating. Seed101 only primary variance.
information_gate: For b1 or b2: ProbeSet mean true gain>0 in EACH snapshot, positive in>=4/5 seeds EACH, mean true gain strictly greater than ProbeIndependent EACH, primary Medium. Exploratory gate, not statistical significance.
cost_gate: No actual saved exact pages proven at fixedK41. Report extra probe byte and QK/AV costs relative to41 pages plus scoring; no expand or kernel unless actual quality-matched savings demonstrated. No stage2 if either gate fails.
stage2: Conditional only. Candidate/background weighted probing and selected-page feedback are not automatically authorized as large sweeps; retain as unrun if stage1 gates fail.
